subject: StitchPay trial - alignment, use case snapshot & slot poll
messages:
From: Sofia Moreno <sofia@stitchpay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a quick demo — StitchPay

Hi Laura,

We just signed up and poked around the Redwood trial — looks promising. I'm Sofia (Head of Integrations at StitchPay). We'd like to line up a short demo this week to see how Redwood would fit into our fraud-detection pipeline (low-latency embeddings + small-batch reranking).

Quick context:
- Use case: embeddings + lightweight rerank to prioritize candidate messages for a downstream classifier.
- Current infra: self-hosted inferencing on mixed GPUs; exploring managed inference to reduce ops overhead.
- Timing: aiming for a POC in the next 6–8 weeks, likely a month-long pilot after that.

Can you share 2–3 quick questions you need answered before scheduling? We'll pull a small traffic slice if that helps.

Thanks,
Sofia Moreno
Head of Integrations, StitchPay
sofia@stitchpay.com

---
Attachment: stitchpay_traffic_sample.csv (CSV, 12 KB, attached by Sofia)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Moreno <sofia@stitchpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — StitchPay

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and thanks for the quick context. Ben (CC) and I can run a tight 30-min session focused on fit and an initial pilot scope. A few quick clarifying questions so we make the demo concrete: 

1) Traffic shape: what's your expected peak concurrent requests and average requests/sec during peak windows? Also, typical sequence lengths (tokens) or average embedding vector sizes?
2) Acceptable latency: do you need p95 < 200ms for rerank/generation, or is 500ms acceptable during pilot?
3) Data residency / privacy: will you need the Private/VPC option for the POC or is hosted okay for now?
4) Integration surface: do you plan to call Redwood via API only, or would you prefer a sidecar/SDK approach?

Proposed times (PDT):
- Mon 10 Aug, 11:00–11:30
- Tue 11 Aug, 14:00–14:30
- Wed 12 Aug, 09:30–10:00

If none of those work, here's my booking link: https://calendly.com/laura-bennett/30min
We can review the attached traffic sample during the call — if you can confirm the CSV contains representative traffic slices (requests/day, average tokens, and a small sample row), that will help us prepare concrete throughput/latency expectations.

Short signature: Laura Bennett
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---

From: Sofia Moreno <sofia@stitchpay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Holt <ryan@stitchpay.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — StitchPay

Thanks Laura — Ben, hi.

Answers inline: 
1) Peak: about 600 reqs/sec during shopping peak windows, sustained bursts to ~1k for 30–60s. Average token length for embeddings ~128 tokens; rerank calls are smaller (around 32–64 tokens).
2) Target: we'd like p95 under ~250ms for the rerank path in production; for the POC, 400–500ms is OK as long as costs look reasonable.
3) Data residency: hosted is fine for the initial POC; production will need EU and US region splitting (we're US-first).
4) Integration: API-first; we plan to call a REST endpoint from our platform.

Attached is a tiny traffic slice: stitchpay_traffic_sample.csv (contains timestamp, request_type, avg_tokens). Let me know if you'd prefer a slightly larger window.

Ryan (added) will be the engineering lead on this — he's on PST as well.

Best,
Sofia

---
Attachment: stitchpay_traffic_sample.csv (CSV, 12 KB, attached by Sofia)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Moreno <sofia@stitchpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ryan Holt <ryan@stitchpay.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — StitchPay

Perfect — thanks for the answers and for attaching the slice. That gives us what we need to prepare a focused 30-min session: short agenda below and I'll include a couple of perf runs/benchmarks based on your CSV.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 5m intros and success metrics for the POC
- 10m traffic/latency expectations and a short perf sketch (what we can guarantee in hosted + config knobs)
- 10m integration pattern (API calls, batching, caching, SDKs) + next steps for a pilot
- 5m Q&A and calendar/ops (SLA, billing, support)

Confirming the Tue 11 Aug, 14:00–14:30 PDT slot works for us. I've tentatively added a calendar invite and will send the Zoom link; if you prefer Wed 12 Aug 09:30 PDT instead, say the word and I'll move it.

Quick ask before the call: if you can share one example request/response shape (either in the CSV or pasted in the thread) that shows the fields you'll send to the embeddings/rerank endpoints, that helps our engineers prepare a mini-integration snippet.

Invite details (provisional):
- Calendar: invite sent to this thread
- Recording: yes (will share after the call)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Laura Bennett
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
Book: https://calendly.com/laura-bennett/30min
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
